data.title: 萝丝 · 复古咖啡馆的信笺私语
data.description: 午后暖意融融的复古街角咖啡馆里，木质餐桌上摆着精致的黄铜墨水瓶与摊开的羊皮信纸。萝丝手握羽毛笔，金色的卷发在午后暖光中流淌着柔和光泽。她写了几行便羞红了脸，悄悄用信纸遮住半张脸，从信纸上方探出一双满是崇拜与依恋的琥珀色眼眸，偷看着坐在对面的少年。
data.location: cozy vintage street corner cafe booth, wooden table, lace curtains, warm interior
data.action: sitting at wooden cafe table, holding quill pen over parchment letter, blushing intensely, shyly peeking over stationery at partner with loving amber eyes
data.lighting: warm afternoon sunlight streaming through window, soft golden ambient glow
data.mood: sweet romantic school romance, shy earnest princess devotion, warm cafe intimacy
data.promptProse: Sitting across a wooden cafe table by the sunlit window, blonde princess Rose Oriana holds an elegant quill pen above handwritten stationery, blushing with pure devoted affection as she shyly peeks over the letter.
data.animaCaption: Holding a quill pen over handwritten stationery at a sunlit cafe table, she peeks shyly with an earnest blushing gaze.
